clips.title: The story
paras: Skittering Blood feeds the Royal Apothecary Society's work on a New Plague. The reagent comes from arachnids in the Skittering Dark of Silverpine Forest, where Forsaken alchemists seek a weapon against the Scourge and humanity.

Skitterweb lurkers, strikers, and their broodmother Krethis the Shadowspinner yield a venomous blood. Apothecary Renferrel found that, refined with toxins from grizzled bear hearts, it forms the base of an exceptionally lethal elixir. Its contaminating agents make it useful in the Apothecarium's chemical experiments.

In the Undercity, Master Apothecary Faranell directs the Royal Apothecary Society's search for a New Plague. The Forsaken face Scourge hordes and hostile human remnants, and turn to biological warfare to even the odds. Faranell studies the blood's toxic strength as he works toward a contagion that can destroy unlife and living flesh alike.
